Non reentrant for the same Pdu Id. Parameters (in) Tx Pdu Id ID of the PDU that has been transmitted. result E_ OK: The PDU was transmitted. E_ NOT_ OK: Transmission of the PDU failed. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description The lower layer communication interface module confirms the transmission of a PDU, or the failure to transmit a PDU. Available via J1939Nm.h
